versions.subject: Add files via upload
versions.detection:
description: add more LOLBins to the rules logic of your choice.
selection1:
  EventLog: security
  EventID: 4688
selection2:
  NewProcessName|endswith:
    - 'regsvr32'
    - 'rundll32'
    - 'msiexec'
    - 'mshta'
    - 'verclsid'
selection3:

  - excel.exe
  - powerpnt.exe
condition: selection1 AND selection2 AND selection3
